title: Bar Drop Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice by Drop is a powerhouse red berry blend. It stacks the sweetness of strawberry, the tang of raspberry, and the deep richness of cherry into one intense profile. A cooling ice exhale sharpens the fruit notes, making this a refreshing and bold choice for berry lovers. This e-liquid features a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, which enhances the definition of each berry type, ensuring the cherry doesn't overpower the strawberry or raspberry. Optimised for low-powered MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) devices, the nicotine salt blend offers a smooth throat hit in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Manufactured by UK brand Drop, Bar Drop Salts range of nic salt e-liquids focus on fruity flavours that are endlessly popular as well as a few unique profiles you won’t find anywhere else.
